record.title: docs(guides): rewrite the user and admin guides around real screen captures

notes: docs-only change plus an opt-in screenshot harness; no runtime code, auth, migration or workflow files touched. web/screenshots/ is outside tsconfig.app.json include (same as e2e/), so `npm run lint`/build are unaffected.

Verified ADMIN_GUIDE claims against code: env vars (internal/platform/config.go reads exactly POSTGRES_DSN/BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN/BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD/ENCRYPTION_KEY), startup log strings in cmd/visitflow/main.go, /readyz fields and error codes in internal/app/server.go, schema version 12 (migrations/0012_email_rules.sql), export limits 10000/50000 (exports.go), retry 5x/5-min backoff (background.go), ipLockoutMultiplier=10 (security.go), /metrics 404 without token (metrics.go), compose hardening/healthcheck values, default mail subject. All match.

Verified USER_GUIDE troubleshooting table: every quoted server/UI message exists verbatim in internal/ or web/src except one — docs/USER_GUIDE.md:61 and :157 call the button `방문 안내 재발송`, but web/src/pages/VisitsPage.tsx:81 labels it `알림 재발송`. Minor doc inaccuracy, worth a follow-up.

docs/USER_GUIDE.md:54 caption promises 진행 기록(신청·승인·입실·퇴실) and 재발급 button, but visits-detail.png shows a pending-approval visit with only the 신청 event and no reissue button (guide.spec.ts clicks the first `상세` row, which is the newest/pending one). Cosmetic mismatch.
README.md:131 points to `aidev/tools/guide/md2pdf.mjs`, which is not in this repository (it lives in the external aidev tooling checkout), so the PDF build is not reproducible from the repo alone.
Two PDFs (~5 MB) and 29 PNGs (~5.7 MB) are committed as binaries; they will need regenerating on each UI change and grow repo history. Acceptable for docs but note the cost.
All 29 image references in both guides resolve to files in docs/assets/guide and every file there is referenced; commit message's count (29) matches.

guide.spec.ts guard: requires URL/ADMIN/PASSWORD env vars and rejects non-loopback hosts without VISITFLOW_SCREENSHOT_ALLOW_REMOTE=1, matching README/commit description. It does create an enabled visit_confirmed SMS rule pointing at sms.example.com and a `lobby01` user on the target; the header comment says so, and the commit message's 'never changes system settings' is accurate in the narrow sense (no /admin/settings writes).
